scope: Diagnosis after the A31-GLOW continuation; standalone marker and a scratch WinForms comparison. No input, no fixture, no screenshot retained.
observations: The visible edge window covered 0,0-2880,1800 and was visible, but its extended style was 0x080900A0 without WS_EX_TOPMOST.
It stayed directly below the foreground window in z-order for one second after readiness, owned by a hidden WinForms taskbar-owner window.
SetWindowPos(HWND_TOPMOST) from another process and after removing the owner returned success without making it topmost.
Edge strips were tinted only where no higher window covered them, so an activated full-screen target hides the glow.

comparison.method: Scratch net9.0-windows program creating 40 px layered, transparent, nonactivating windows

conclusion: Product defect: the marker never enters the topmost band, so a TRACE-activated or foreground target covers it. Create the edge windows with TopMost=true.
fix: Applied with the alpha.3.2 implementation; verified there by a labeled focused regression that cannot promote A31-GLOW.
